newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos, forwards flat, bonds firm in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos, forwards flat, bonds firm in late trade.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were idling in late trade holding morning levels and ecu/drachma was trading lower around 304.10 on sales of 75 million ecus for drachmas, dealers said. Bonds were bouyant in late dealing.

"Depos and forex forwards have been stable today," said a dealer at a state bank. "The market is very liquid and it looks like there might hev been some overshooting in forex forwards on the downside."
The central bank drained overnight funds at an unchnaged 12.40 percent.
The market ia awaiting for the central bank to slash its intervention bid to 11.90 or 12 percent in one or two steps.
The December CPI inflation stood at 7.5 percent year-on-year, down from 7.7 percent in November but core inflation rose to 8.2 percent year-on-year in December from 8.0 percent in November.
Prices of coupon bonds and FRNs continued to nudge higher in late trade, dealers said.

"1997 could turn out to be a marvelous year for Greek bonds if certain changes in the institutional framework take place such as short-selling, securities lending and primary dealers," said a bond dealer at a foreign bank.
The mark was quoted at 156.65/61 drachmas from Thursday's 156.585 fix, the dollar at 246.50/60 drachmas from 247.290 and the Ecu at 304.12/17 from 304.160 drachmas.
